policy.evidence: Paired constraint predictions made before each new optimizer observation; the research data fit both models but do not count as prior-adoption trials

evaluation.rule: Public evaluation coordinates and all final Program/GP predictions are frozen after each optimizer run. After every selected run is complete, a separate actual simulator stream supplies shared measurements and evaluator-only true constraint means. Evaluation calls never enter the controller and are reported separately.
evaluation.additional_requested_metrics: Record which experimental controls provide useful measured objective values, objective prediction errors on actual future observations, final objective-GP predictions on the same frozen independent controls when available, and the best measured point after the mechanism change. Preserve the original constraint Program/GP errors, confirmation and revision sequence, feasibility, and paid costs.

method: After an actual accepted constraint-scope revision, install an equal-weight native sequential mixture of the supported frozen program and its adaptive affine GP readout. Update weights using future predictive likelihoods; propagate component uncertainty and disagreement through native fantasy KG. Nominate one differentiating control from public available_probes alongside terminal objective offers, preserving the ordinary native candidate pool. Disagreement only nominates the candidate and is not added to the KG score. Initial learned priors without a constraint-scope revision remain outside this branch. This is probabilistic predictive competition, not a paired-loss hard adoption rule. Nomination compute is included in recovery compute and must not be added twice.
selection: All163 existing paths with an actual constraint-scope revision, including119 with terminal objective actions and103 with objective repetitions. All163 require execution, because retaining the program can affect paths without repetitions. Run four no-entry controls and reuse323 other no-entry paths. Fifteen development cases include the diagnosed previous fresh failure, cases where the GP remains better than the program, late revisions, zero-noise cases, and all four no-entry controls.
reuse_rule: The new policy begins only at an actual accepted constraint-scope revision. Reuse a complete v0.50 path when no scope revision occurred and it is not one of the four actual controls. No prior run is described as a newly executed trajectory.
accounting: 163 historical method runs plus4 controls and54 fresh paired runs cost7072 online calls. Fresh shared acquisition costs384 initial and1920 evaluator calls. Each arm uses32 initial and32 online calls; fifteen development runs cost480 online calls and are included once. Historical initial/evaluator data and v0.50 outcomes are reused. Report program/GP comparisons, experiment scoring and GP update costs independently. No new v0.48, strict50, vanilla or CodeAgent runs.
source_loading: Freeze the adopted ten-module v0.50 source and the complete intervention modules including constraint_retention.py before execution; use each arm's frozen module package.
limitations: Existing490 are development evidence, including the prior27 newly inspected cases. Execute and report the independently predeclared fresh27 separately after development is promising. Missing historical measured objective evaluator labels remain missing; saved true means are used only for explicitly labelled true MSE. Reused historical wall time does not establish simultaneous runtime improvement.
